subject: MAP execution: signoff checklist, signature timing & start date
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Zhang <c.zhang@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 5 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP execution: signoff checklist, signature timing & start date

Claire / Tom —

Thanks again for the time this week. Attached is the final mutual action plan (RDW_MAP_v5.xlsx) with the dates we discussed for evaluation milestones, procurement handoffs, and the paper-signing window. I pulled the legal and SOW items into a short packet so procurement has everything they need to route for signatures.

Key asks from our side to keep the go/no-go on track:
- Can procurement confirm the internal approval path and whether Acme requires a PO before signature?
- Will legal need any redlines beyond the SOW we attached?
- Confirm preferred signature date range (we suggested 2026-07-20 to 2026-07-24).

If you give us a green light on those three items by EOD Tuesday (7/7), we can have the DocuSign envelope ready for your approver list on 7/20 and start onboarding on 8/1 as planned.

Attachments: [Attachment: RDW_MAP_v5.xlsx (spreadsheet, 38KB)], [Attachment: Statement_of_Work_v2.pdf (pdf, 72KB)], [Attachment: Redwood_Security_Summary.pdf (pdf, 120KB)]

—
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
https://redwood.ai

From: Claire Zhang <c.zhang@acmehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@acmehealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 5 Jul 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP execution: signoff checklist, signature timing & start date

Ben —

Thanks for the packet, looks thorough. A few quick clarifications from procurement/legal side:

1) PO / timing: Acme typically issues a PO before countersignature for platform engagements over $250k. We are treating this as a standard engagement but I will confirm whether procurement can defer PO issuance until after DocuSign if needed.

2) SOW redlines: Our legal has two small asks around data retention language and an SLA clause referencing uptime that we want clarified. I copied Procurement on this thread and will forward the redlines by Monday.

3) Signature window: 7/20–7/24 works, but the approver (CTO) will be traveling during that window; we may need to target 7/27 if a PO is required. Can you hold that later date as a fallback?

We will aim to send procurement's internal approval path and the redlines by EOD Monday. If you need anything else to prepare the DocuSign envelope, let me know.

Claire Zhang
Director, Product Integrations
Acme Health
c.zhang@acmehealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0789

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP execution: signoff checklist, signature timing & start date

Claire / procurement team —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A few notes responding to your bullets:

1) PO: We can accommodate a PO-before-signature flow. If you end up needing a PO, please advise and we'll shift the signing window to 7/27–7/30. We can prepare DocuSign immediately after the PO is issued.

2) Legal redlines: Marissa (cc'd) on our legal team will review any redlines you send. Typically the data retention language can be tightened via an addendum to the SOW; SLA uptime clarifications are fine — we can provide the standard Redwood SLA excerpt so your team can compare.

3) Kickoff/start date: To keep your engineering ramping without delay, we suggest a contractual start date of 2026-08-01. If signature slips to late July, we can still hit that start date as long as onboarding docs are exchanged the week prior.

Next steps I propose (short and actionable):
- Claire/procurement: send PO guidance + any redlines by EOD Monday (7/6).
- Marissa: I'll queue the SOW/SLA excerpt and a short addendum template for data retention.
- Ben: prepare DocuSign envelope and list of Redwood signers once approver list confirmed.

I'll attach the short SOW excerpt for your review.

Attachments: [Attachment: Statement_of_Work_v2.pdf (pdf, 72KB)]

—
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: MAP execution: signoff checklist, signature timing & start date

Ben / Marissa / Rishi —

Quick update from procurement/legal:

- Procurement confirmed they will issue the PO on 7/22, which allows signature the week of 7/27.
- Legal attached two redline markers; nothing material — they requested the data retention clause changed to a 90-day archival review and asked for the standard uptime table to be appended to the SOW.
- Approver list: CTO + Head of Compliance (both need to sign). CTO is available on 7/28 AM PT.

Given that, Acme proposes:
- DocuSign envelope to be sent 7/27 with target signatures 7/28;
- Contract effective date: 2026-08-01;
- Onboarding kickoff: week of 8/3 (one-week buffer after effective date).

Marissa — will you be able to accept the two redlines as an addendum and confirm Redwood signers for the DocuSign envelope?

Claire
